fr_html: M. FERNANDES demande si, au sens du texte, le Conseil et l'Assemblée auront à choisir dans une liste plus ou moins large proposée par la commission médiatrice, ou s'ils devront adopter ou rejeter la proposition faite par cette commission.
en_html: M. FERNANDES asked whether the meaning of the text was that the Council and the Assembly would have to choose from a more or less extensive list proposed by the Joint Conference, or whether they would have to adopt or reject the proposal made by the Joint Conference.
